Summary: Payment shall be made no later than 30 days from the date of submission of the Stage Payment Statement for an IPC, or from the date of submission of the Final Payment Certificate for Works.
Quote: payment shall be made no later than 30 (thirty) days from the date of submission of the Stage Payment Statement by the Contractor to the Authority’s Engineer for certification in accordance with the provisions of Clause 19.4 for an IPC
Notes: Clause 19.5 also mentions a 10-day payment window for part payment of a Stage Payment Statement after recommendation by the Authority's Engineer, but the primary payment term for certified amounts / IPCs and final payments is 30 days under Clause 19.9.

Summary: The Authority shall deduct 6% from every payment for Works as Retention Money, subject to a maximum cap of 5% of the Contract Price.
Quote: From every payment for Works due to the Contractor in accordance with the provisions of Clause 19.5, the Authority shall deduct 6% (six per cent) thereof as guarantee money for performance of the obligations of the Contractor during the Construction Period (the “Retention Money”) subject to the condition that the maximum amount of Retention Money shall not exceed 5% (five per cent) of the Contract Price.
Notes: The per-bill deduction is 6%, but the text specifies a maximum cap of 5% of the Contract Price.

Summary: An interest-bearing mobilization advance equal to 10% of the Contract Price payable in two equal instalments of 5% each, with interest at Bank Rate + 3%.
Quote: The Authority shall make an interest-bearing advance payment (the “Advance Payment”) @ “Bank Rate + 3%”, equal to 10 % (ten percent) of the Contract Price, exclusively for mobilisation expenses. The Advance Payment for mobilisation expenses shall be made in two instalments each equal to 5% (five percent) of the Contract Price.
Notes: The advance is interest-bearing at Bank Rate + 3% and is made in two instalments of 5% each. An additional equipment advance of up to 5% of the Contract Price is also mentioned in Clause 19.2(ii).

Unit: % per day of the Contract Price
Summary: The contractor pays damages of 0.05% of the Contract Price for each day of delay in achieving a Project Milestone or the Scheduled Completion Date.
Quote: In the event that the Contractor fails to achieve any Project Milestone or the Scheduled Completion Date within a period of 30 (thirty) days from the date set forth in Schedule-J, unless such failure has occurred due to Force Majeure or for reasons solely attributable to the Authority, it shall pay Damages to the Authority of a sum calculated at the rate of 0.05% (zero point zero five percent) of the Contract Price for delay of each day reckoned from the date specified in Schedule –J and until such Project Milestone is achieved or the Project Highway is completed
Notes: Appears on page 67 (clause numbering implied by context, text refers to Scheduled Completion Date and Project Milestones).

Summary: The amounts payable to the Contractor for Works and Maintenance shall be adjusted for changes in rates and prices of inputs in accordance with the provisions of Clauses 19.10 and 19.12.
Quote:
19.10  Price adjustment for the Works
(i)
The amounts payable to the Contractor for Works shall be adjusted in accordance
with the provisions of this Clause 19.10
Notes: Price adjustment applies to both Works (Clause 19.10) and Maintenance of Project Highway (Clause 19.12) using specific input components and formulae.

Summary: The contractor must furnish an irrevocable and unconditional bank guarantee for the Performance Security equal to 3% of its Bid Price.
Quote: Within 30 (thirty) days of receipt of Letter of Acceptance, the selected Bidder shall furnish to the Authority an irrevocable and unconditional guarantee from a Bank in the form set forth in Annex-I of Schedule-G (the “Performance Security”) for an amount equal to 3% (Three percent) of its Bid Price.
Notes: The Performance Security must be provided as an irrevocable and unconditional bank guarantee. It shall be valid until 60 days after the Defects Liability Period. Additional Performance Security may also be required under certain conditions.
